summary: Iter 56 — Frontend-only verification of (A) Profile navigation from /messages and (B) AdminWidgets Badges editor color/gradient/glow pickers. Login as founder stealth/Password1$ succeeded; logout via /settings/account and re-login both work. On /messages Chats tab, three peer rows exist (tfone, support, morpheus); clicking chat-row-tfone-avatar AND chat-row-tfone-name navigate to /profile/tfone. Clicking chat-row-tfone-open opens dm-overlay (no navigation). From inside the open DM overlay, dm-header-avatar and dm-header-name BOTH navigate to /profile/tfone and the overlay closes before navigating. Self-guard verified: no chat-row-stealth-* testids render in own chats list. Realms tab dj realm chat has no peer message bubbles in this dataset so the msg-sender-<u> nav is SKIPPED (per spec). Groups tab is empty (no group convo). On /admin/widgets Badges tab, Create Badge editor exposes ALL required pickers: color (swatch+text), gradient (from/to/swatch each, angle slider, raw CSS textbox, 6 presets gold/green/blue/sunset/violet/ocean), glow (swatch+text+clear), and live badge-form-preview. Clicking the Blue preset wrote `linear-gradient(135deg, #2EA0FF 0%, #6CC4FF 100%)` to badge-form-gradient-css and the preview pill background-image computed to `linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(46, 160, 255) 0%, rgb(108, 196, 255) 100%)` — mirrors the runtime renderer. Created qa_badge_<ts> with gradient+glow #FFAA00, Save closed the editor and the new badge appeared in the list. Re-opening via badge-edit-<key> round-tripped gradient + glow correctly. Cleanup delete via badge-delete-<key> with auto-accepted window.confirm removed the badge. Reconcile button present and Widgets tab still renders without regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Messages.openPeerProfile (Messages.jsx L208-212) cleanly short-circuits on empty username OR self-match — prevents the bouncing-to-own-profile UX bug.

GOOD: Chat row markup correctly splits the avatar + name into sibling <button> elements next to the open-DM <button>, avoiding nested <button-in-button> a11y violation while keeping the click targets discrete and testable.

GOOD: DM overlay header navigation closes the overlay (state cleared) before calling navigate(), so back-button from /profile/<u> returns the user to /messages cleanly rather than re-opening the overlay.

GOOD: ProfileBadges renderer parity — BadgePreview component (AdminWidgets.jsx L1212+) mirrors the runtime BadgePill styles (background gradient + glow box-shadow via fallback color), so admins see exactly what end users will see.
GOOD: GRADIENT_PRESETS (L1081-1088) emit canonical `linear-gradient(135deg, ...)` strings which are consumable by the backend gradient field as-is (no normalisation needed).
GOOD: ColorPicker falls back to #00FF66 for invalid hex (L1041) so the native <input type=color> never throws — defensive against partial hex inputs while typing.

NIT: dm-header-avatar/name buttons sit inside the sticky overlay header which scrolls off-screen on tall conversations — a regular Playwright click() returns 'outside viewport'. Real users won't hit this (they see the sticky header), but consider position:sticky/fixed in the header bar to make the elements perpetually clickable AND test-friendly.

NIT: The realm/group msg-sender-<u> click path could not be exercised in this run because the dj realm has zero peer messages and Groups is empty in this dataset. Backend logic is straightforward (mirror of openPeerProfile) but a seeded peer-message in a known realm would let us E2E that path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on exercised paths — login OK, 4/4 Messages nav paths OK (chat-row avatar+name, dm-header avatar+name), self-guard OK, no nested button violations, 14/14 AdminWidgets badge editor checks OK (all pickers present, preset writes CSS + reflects in preview, save+roundtrip+delete cleanup all pass, reconcile+widgets tab intact, logout+re-login OK). msg-sender-<u> nav SKIPPED (no seeded peer message in available realm/group conversations).

seed_data_creation: Iter 56 created exactly one QA badge `qa_badge_<unix-ts>` with gradient + glow #FFAA00, then deleted it via badge-delete-<key> before exiting. Registry is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile nav from Messages and Badge editor pickers are fully verified on the public preview URL. Selectors used: signin-email, signin-password, signin-submit, chat-row-<u>-avatar/-name/-open, dm-overlay, dm-header-avatar, dm-header-name, msg-sender-<u>, badges-create, badge-editor, badge-form-{color,gradient-from,gradient-to,gradient-angle,gradient-css,gradient-preset-<name>,glow,glow-clear,preview,key,name,save}, badge-edit-<k>, badge-delete-<k>, admin-widgets-tab-{widgets,badges}. The msg-sender-<u> path was the only spec item we could not exercise — Groups tab is empty for `stealth` and the dj realm chat had no peer bubbles. To E2E this, seed a group with `tfone` as member who sends a message, then have stealth open it and click @tfone. The DM header element gets pushed above the viewport when the convo scroll is at the bottom — use page.evaluate(el.click()) instead of Playwright .click() to bypass the viewport check for automated tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — both feature additions verified working as specified.
